Bill.BriefDescription: Relating to an expansion of local option real estate excise taxes in lieu of impact fees to fund capital projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an expansion of local option real estate excisetaxes in lieu of impact fees to fund capital projects.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This act shall be known as the expansion oflocal option real estate excise taxes in lieu of impact fees act of2005.
